name: Cilium Dataplane Diagnostics
summary: Rank competing explanations of observed Cilium datapath behavior (non-policy drops, intermittent timeouts, Service VIP unreachable with healthy pods, conntrack and BPF map pressure, kube-proxy replacement and socket load balancing, MTU, routing, endpoint regeneration) from supplied evidence, and name the next least-invasive observation that separates them. Includes capacity headroom from supplied counts. Static review: never runs commands, execs into the agent, captures packets or changes configuration.
security_notes: Static review only. Proposes cilium-dbg, hubble and tcpdump observations with their command class (privileged observation or higher) for an authorized operator; never requests sysdump or bugtool archives, which can contain configuration and keys.
